abound: Ab + unda: wave overflow. Fish abound here.
congenial: Con + genius: same spirit. A congenial group.
deify: Deus + facere. They deified the king.
misanthropic: Miso + anthropos: hates mankind. A misanthropic hermit.
misnomer: Mis + nomen: wrong name. Peanut is a misnomer.
negligent: Neg + legere: not pick up. Negligent driver.
anachronistic: Out of time. An anachronistic custom.
incredulous: In + credere: not believe. An incredulous stare.
cacophonous: Kakos + phone: bad sound. A cacophonous street.
canonize: Canon: rule. Canonized as a saint.
compelling: Com + pellere: drive. A compelling case.
contend: Con + tendere: strain against. Contend for the title.
incendiary: In + candere: set aflame. Incendiary speech.
profundity: Pro + fundus: deep. Profundity of thought.
prophetic: Pro + phemi: speak forth. Prophetic warning.
tranquil: Trans + quies: beyond disturbance. A tranquil lake.
clangor: Clangere: ring. The clangor of bells.
conventional: Con + venire: come together. Conventional wisdom.
discernible: Dis + cernere: separate out. Barely discernible.
extravagant: Extra + vagari: wander beyond. Extravagant gifts.
invasive: In + vadere: go into. Invasive weeds.
dogged: Dog gripping a bone. Dogged pursuit.
entitled: Title. Entitled to a refund; an entitled brat.
pertinacious: Per + tenax: very holding. A pertinacious critic.
subvert: Sub + vertere: turn from beneath. Subvert authority.
explicable: Ex + plicare: unfold. An explicable result.
conjectural: Con + jacere: throw together. Conjectural theory.
decadent: De + cadere: fall. A decadent dessert.
oust: Obstare: stand in the way. Oust the chairman.
